geometry_authoring: Original procedural editable mesh, not photogrammetry or a surveyed as-built model

primary_source.title: Sagrada Familia Information Booklet 9: Interior of the Basilica
primary_source.publisher: Fundacio Junta Constructora del Temple Expiatori de la Sagrada Familia
primary_source.publication_date: 02/2026 edition verified visually by independent QA; stable architectural evidence, not current work-completion evidence

facts.columns: Intersecting opposite helicoidal forms, elliptical knots, repeated branching. Sandstone at aisles, granite in nave, basalt at crossing perimeter, red porphyry for four central supports.
facts.vaults: Hyperboloid skylights; white concrete aisles; central Catalan tiles with green and gold mosaic. Rising radial apse tiers.
facts.choirs: Side horseshoe and apse children's gallery; railings feature musical staves.
facts.apse: Seven chapels; presbytery bounded by ten columns and raised two metres.
facts.altar: Porphyry monolith 2.72m long; suspended crucifix; heptagonal baldachin five metres across and fifty lamps.
facts.glass: Cool Nativity-side colour, warm Passion-side colour; increasing transparency upwards. Actual glazing is authored separately.

primary_source.rights: Official PDF and photographs used privately as visual references. No reference photograph is mapped onto, embedded in or redistributed with runtime geometry.
